**Attribution**
OPERA was developed by Kamel Mansouri and colleagues at the U.S. EPA National Center for Computational Toxicology and the NIEHS (kamel.mansouri@nih.gov), and is distributed from the NIEHS GitHub organisation under the MIT licence (`<https://github.com/NIEHS/OPERA>`_). Molecular descriptors are calculated with PaDEL-Descriptor 1.00 and the Chemistry Development Kit (CDK) 2.0. Model descriptions (QMRFs) are available from the JRC QSAR Model Database (`<https://qsardb.jrc.ec.europa.eu/qmrf/endpoint>`_).

xml.name: macro_endpoints
xml.option: StrP - General structural properties (MW, atom counts, rings, H-bond donors/acceptors, TPSA, ...)
BP - Boiling point (deg. C, 760 mm Hg)
WS - Water solubility (log10 Mol/L at 25 deg. C)
RT - HPLC retention time (min, obsolete model)
LogD - Octanol-water distribution coefficient at pH 5.5 and 7.4
AOH - OH rate constant for atmospheric gas-phase reactions (log10 cm3/molecule-sec)
LogKM - Whole-body primary biotransformation rate constant (log10 days)
CATMoS - Acute oral toxicity (EPA/GHS category and LD50)
Clint - Human hepatic intrinsic clearance (ul/min/10^6 cells)
Caco2 - Caco-2 membrane permeability (logPapp, log cm/s)

xml.name: macro_endpoint_groups
xml.option: PC - Physicochemical properties (LogP, MP, BP, VP, WS, HL, KOA, RT, pKa, LogD)
EF - Environmental fate (LogBCF, AOH, BioDeg, RBiodeg, LogKM, LogKoc)
